message.content:
In standard Blackjack, **an Ace can be worth either 1 point or 11 points**—whichever gives your hand the best possible score without going over 21.

### How it works:

| Hand | Value |
|------|-------|
| Ace + 5 | 16 (ace=10) |
| Ace + 9 | 20 (ace=10) |
| Ace + Queen | 21 (blackjack) |
| Two Aces | 12 (one ace=11, one ace=1) |

* If counting the Ace as 11 keeps the total ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
* If treating it as 11 would make you “bust” (> 21), you automatically switch that Ace to 1 instead.

This flexibility lets players maximize their chances of staying under 21 while still having a strong hand when possible.
